segments.title: Arrive Tokyo
segments.plan: Land mid-afternoon, drop bags, evening walk in Shibuya. Dinner at Aoba Counter.

segments.title: Tokyo, walk-in ramen and neighbourhoods
segments.plan: Lunch at Midori Bowl (walk-in). Afternoon in a quiet neighbourhood.

segments.title: More Tokyo
segments.plan: Optional Tabelog lunch at Nishi Market Diner. Slow museum and park days.

segments.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto
segments.plan: Morning Hikari to Kyoto, check in, evening walk along the river.

segments.title: Kyoto, timed-ticket pavilion
segments.plan: Lantern Garden Pavilion if tickets are bought. Dinner at Kamo Shojin.

segments.title: Kyoto at a walking pace
segments.plan: Temples and a neighbourhood walk. No reservations required.

segments.title: Fly home from Kansai
segments.plan: Airport express to KIX, afternoon flight to San Francisco.
